sovereign_country.strategic_role: 欧洲最大实体经济体、高公信力工业与跨境电商本土实体（GmbH）

business_scope.primary_industry_name: High-End Loose-Leaf Tea Service and Cultural Ceramic Salons

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Convention on the Reciprocal Encouragement and Protection of Investments between the Federal Republic of Germany and the People's Republic of China (2003)
Germany-United States Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (1989/2006)
Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU) — freedom of establishment under Articles 49-55
Germany-Netherlands Double Taxation Agreement and accompanying protocol, as amended

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Geldwäschegesetz (GwG) of 23 June 2017, BGBl. I S. 1822, as amended by the Transparenzregister- und Finanzinformationengesetz (TraFinG) and subsequent EU AML/CFT transposition acts; UBO disclosure obligation under § 20 GwG; beneficial ownership definition under § 3 Abs. 1 GwG; EU AML Directives (AMLD4/AMLD5) as implemented; registry filing duties for the Transparenzregister under §§ 1, 2, 20 GwG; notarial attestation requirements under § 10 Abs. 1 Nr. 3 GwG.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or government-issued ID of each shareholder and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the nationality jurisdiction; German notary certifies compliance with EU identity rules
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for contracting states; consular legalization for non-apostille jurisdictions; German notarial identity certification for EU/EEA documents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proposed articles of association (Gesellschaftsvertrag or Musterprotokoll) executed before a German notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic German notarization; no foreign apostille or consular legalization required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Landlord's written consent to the registered office or signed subordination agreement concerning the business address
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization if the lessor is a foreign legal entity; otherwise domestic notarization and German certified translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing, corporate register extract, or equivalent evidence if any shareholder is a legal entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign company registry / competent corporate registrar of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization according to the registrant state; sworn German translation mandatory

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all managing directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, and authorized signatories under §§ 5 and 6 GwG. Screening is performed against the European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council sanctions lists, German national sanctions maintained by BAFA/Bundesbank, and, in cross-border payment scenarios, the OFAC SDN List. Political-exposure reviews are conducted under Art. 3(9) of AMLD4/AMLD5; enhanced due diligence, including source-of-funds verification and senior-management approval, is triggered for PEPs. The protocol follows the guidance of the German FIU and is documented in the pre-incorporation AML file.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Handelsregister online (www.handelsregister.de) and Unternehmensregister (www.unternehmensregister.de); official filing via a certified notary through the German electronic register system
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be registered in German/Latin script. Non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into the German Latin alphabet, and a sworn German transliteration may be required. The name must satisfy the distinctiveness and lack-of-deception requirements of §§ 17-19 HGB; German umlauts (ä, ö, ü) and ß are permissible in the register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The notary may reserve the proposed name with the competent Amtsgericht for up to 30 days. If the register court rejects the name, the applicant or notary must file a formal appeal (Beschwerde) with the same Amtsgericht within two weeks of notification, stating why the name is distinctive and not misleading under §§ 17-19 HGB. If the Amtsgericht maintains its rejection, a further appeal (Rechtsbeschwerde) to the Oberlandesgericht may be filed. Before rejection, the notary should obtain a name-reservation extension or amend the name with a distinguishing suffix, such as 'Tea Salon' or a geographic identifier, and re-file through the same electronic procedure.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Limited to secondary correspondence address only; a wholly virtual registered seat is inadmissible for trade licensing and food-sector operations under §§ 4, 5 GmbHG and § 14 GewO. The specialty tea salon must maintain a physical, fully equipped and operational business location, accessible during business hours, with commercial substance sufficient for turnover tax, trade tax, and food-safety registration.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High — approximately 75% within the first 12 months for food-hygiene and consumer-protection inspections by the local food monitoring authority; municipal trade-office inspections and tax-audit risk of 10-20% in the first full business year are separately applicable.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial deed of the GmbH articles and UBO declaration protocol
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under GNotKG §§ 58(1), 99, based on notional share capital amount; market benchmark approx. EUR 1,200

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Handelsregister entry fee and name-check/reservation request
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: German court fees under Gerichtskostengesetz; standard GmbH HRB entry fee approx. EUR 300

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Gewerbeanmeldung and municipal business-license processing fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: State/local administrative fee ordinance; flat fee EUR 20-60 depending on municipality

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Food-hygiene operating permit and initial food-safety consultation for specialty tea lounge
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Local Food Monitoring Office / Veterinary and Food Inspection Authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: State food-law administrative fee tariff; EUR 80-150 including inspection fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO/AML/KYC due-diligence file preparation and PEP/sanctions screening by certified AML officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External compliance lawyer or certified AML consultant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate; EUR 650 for 2-3 hours of senior professional time, analog § 35 RVG

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified German translations of foreign commercial, identity, and corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Judicial Compensation Act (JVEG) per-page tariff; approx. USD 250 for 10 pages

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered-office lease review and landlord's consent notarization
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fee; notarial fee for address consent and lease review approx. EUR 800

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: German Limited Liability Companies Act (Gesetz betreffend die Gesellschaften mit beschränkter Haftung – GmbHG), Sections 1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 35, 39, 46–48; Commercial Code (Handelsgesetzbuch – HGB) Sections 8–12; Court Fees Act (Gerichts- und Notarkostengesetz – GNotKG) Part 2, Section 4.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registergericht (Commercial Register Department, Abteilung B – Handelsregister/HRB) of the competent Amtsgericht (Local Court) having jurisdiction over the registered office, e.g., Amtsgericht Berlin-Charlottenburg for Berlin.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarially certified 'Anmeldung zur Eintragung' together with the certified Articles of Association (Gesellschaftsvertrag) or the simplified model protocol (Musterprotokoll) per Section 2(1a) GmbHG; registration recorded as the HRB entry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum registered share capital is EUR 25,000.00 (GmbHG Section 5(1)); before the registration application, at least one half (EUR 12,500.00) of the cash share capital must be paid up irrevocably in cash (GmbHG Section 7(2)) and placed at the free disposal of the managing director in a dedicated escrow account (GmbHG Section 7(3)); the paying-in must be evidenced by a bank cash-confirmation (Geldverkehrsbestätigung) under GmbHG Section 8(2).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: We, the undersigned founding shareholders and appointed managing directors of the Company, hereby adopt this first board resolution. First, each shareholder irrevocably subscribes to the business shares stated in the signed subscription schedule, aggregating the fully paid-up registered share capital of EUR 25,000.00. Second, the registered office of the Company is fixed and adopted as [Street, Postal Code, City], the jurisdiction recorded in the Articles of Association. Third, [Name] is appointed managing director (Geschäftsführer), acting as sole representative under § 6 GmbHG. Fourth, the managing director is authorized to open the capital escrow account, execute the commercial register application, and procure all licenses necessary for commencement of the specialty tea salon operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Articles of Association and Share Subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notar) with public office in the district of the registered office (Amtsgerichtsbezirk).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding shareholders appear personally before the notary, present valid identity documents, and declare their subscription. The notary reads out the draft Articles or the simplified Musterprotokoll, verifies identity and legal capacity, and certifies the deed, including number and par value of shares subscribed against the EUR 25,000.00 minimum capital. Upon certification, the notary lodges the commercial register application electronically and advises on the admissibility requirements under GmbHG Section 8.
required_dossiers: Original valid passport or national identity card of each founding shareholder
Draft Articles of Association or Musterprotokoll (Annex 1 to GmbHG)
Proof of registered-office address (street, postal code, city)
Power of attorney if a shareholder is represented
AML/source-of-funds declarations if requested by the notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies formal defects or conflicting provisions, a supplementary notarial corrective deed (Berichtigungsakte) is executed; if identity or capacity is challenged, the appointment is rescheduled with corrected documents, or another competent notary is engaged.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the Capital Escrow Account and Payment of Cash Contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed credit institution in Germany (bank, Sparkasse, or commercial bank) chosen for the formation account.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: On the strength of the notarial deed, the company in formation ('GmbH i.G.') opens a dedicated capital escrow account named 'GmbH i.G. [Name] – Kapitalkonto'. The required cash payment of at least EUR 12,500.00 is transferred by the shareholders without right of withdrawal until registration. After receipt, the bank issues a cash-confirmation (Geldverkehrsbestätigung) under GmbHG Section 8(2) stating the confirmed credit amount, payer, and free disposal by the managing director; formation costs may not be debited from the mandatory half-payment.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the notarized Articles of Association
Specimen signature of the managing director
Identity documents of the depositing shareholder/managing director
AML questionnaire and source-of-funds evidence
Draft commercial register application for bank compliance review
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the bank requires enhanced due diligence, the managing director supplies verified source-of-funds statements and corporate documents; if the selected bank declines the mandate, the deposit is transferred to another licensed credit institution and a new cash-confirmation is obtained.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Electronic Filing of the Commercial Register Application (Anmeldung)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public, filing via the secure electronic attorney-communication channel (beA) to the Registergericht of the competent Local Court.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The managing director signs the standardized Anmeldung declaration confirming that all mandatory contributions are paid up and at free disposal. The notary certifies the signature(s) and transmits, together with the Articles of Association (or Musterprotokoll), the certified list of shareholders, the bank cash-confirmation, and the managing director's specimen signature. The application must be signed by all managing directors (GmbHG Section 8(1) No. 2) and must identify the persons authorized to represent the company.
required_dossiers: Anmeldung zur Eintragung (notarially certified)
List of shareholders with business shares per GmbHG Section 8(1) No. 3
Bank cash-confirmation (Geldverkehrsbestätigung)
Specimen signature page of the managing director
Articles of Association / Musterprotokoll
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registergericht issues an interlocutory order (Zwischenverfügung), the notary or counsel cures the formal defect within the set grace period (usually four to six weeks) by filing an amended shareholder list, a supplementary declaration, or a corrected application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register Court Review and Entry of the GmbH into the Commercial Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Amtsgericht – Registergericht, Commercial Register Department (Abteilung B, HRB).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The register judge verifies legal admissibility, capital maintenance, the completeness of the shareholder list, and the managing director's eligibility. Upon approval, the GmbH is entered in the HRB register of the competent Local Court and the court orders electronic publication (Bekanntmachung) in the digital federal gazette. The entry provides constructive notice under HGB Section 15, establishes the legal personality of the GmbH, and triggers the statutory liability shield.
required_dossiers: Complete notarized registration file transmitted by the notary
Proof of capital payment / bank cash-confirmation
Declaration of formation costs and pre-incorporation liabilities
Copy of the first board resolution for the register file
Confirmation of court fee payment (approx. EUR 70 entry plus EUR 30 publication under GNotKG)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the court rejects or queries the application, supplementary declarations are filed within the judicial deadline; further refusal can be appealed to the Higher Regional Court (Oberlandesgericht) under Section 382 of the Family Procedure Act (FamFG).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Trade Registration and Gaststätten Licensing Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gewerbeamt / Ordnungsamt (Trade Licensing and Regulatory Office) of the municipality where the specialty tea salon operates.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The managing director submits the Gewerbeanmeldung (online through the municipal portal or GewerbeOnline) for code ISIC 5630 / NAICS 722515 and obtains the trade registration certificate, which is simultaneously transmitted to the Tax Office. Concurrently, the manager files the Gaststättenerlaubnis application under Section 2 of the Gaststättengesetz for the serving of beverages and prepared foods, supported by the required reliability and site-location documentation.
required_dossiers: Participate in a Commercial register extract (HRB entry)
Official ID and residence proof of the managing director
Gewerbeanmeldung form or electronic submission receipt
Gaststättenerlaubnis application form
Lease agreement with landlord's written consent
Building/occupancy certificate where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the licensing authority questions the applicant's reliability or the premises suitability, the manager submits a police certificate of conduct, tax clearance, and an amended floor plan; any adverse administrative order may be challenged within one month under the Administrative Procedure Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fiscal Registration with the Tax Office (Finanzamt)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Finanzamt (Tax Office) with jurisdiction for the GmbH's registered office; submissions via the ELSTER online portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within four weeks of commercial register entry, the managing director submits the tax registration questionnaire (Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung) via ELSTER, declaring estimated turnover, profit expectations, and payroll data for corporate income tax, trade tax, VAT, and wage tax purposes. The Finanzamt issues the corporate tax number and, upon verification of export or advance VAT return data, registers the company for VAT and allocates the VAT identification number (USt-IdNr.) where not already applied for under Section 27a UStG.
required_dossiers: Commercial register extract (HRB entry)
Trade registration certificate from the Gewerbeamt
Notarized Articles of Association
Lease contract and opening balance sheet or income forecast
Managing director's personal tax identification number
Completed tax questionnaire and preliminary VAT return
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Finanzamt seeks clarifications, the managing director responds in writing within the prescribed two-to-four-week period, supplying corrected forecasts and documentation; provisional VAT ID issuance can be requested for urgent invoicing while the final assessment is pending.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Public Health, Fire Safety, Environmental, and Operating Clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gesundheitsamt (Public Health Office), Feuerwehr / Amt für Brandschutz (Fire Protection Authority), Untere Wasserbehörde / Umweltamt (Environmental Water Authority), and Bauamt (Building Office).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Food-handling staff complete the infection-protection briefing under Section 43 IfSG, and the tea salon is registered as a food business per Article 6(2) of EU Regulation 852/2004. A pre-opening hygiene inspection verifies tea preparation zones and washing facilities; the fire authority audits rescue routes and extinguisher provisions; a DIN EN 1825 grease separator is installed for wastewater pre-treatment, and the salon registers as an indirect discharger under Section 58 of the Water Resources Act (WHG). Final approval is recorded and the licenses file is consolidated with the Gewerbeamt.
required_dossiers: Health instruction certificates (Bescheinigung nach § 43 IfSG) for all food handlers
Floor plan with kitchen, escape routes, and equipment layout
Fire safety concept with extinguishing equipment maintenance contract
Structural load certificate for seating systems or mezzanine installations
Grease separator installation certificate and service contract
Waste disposal contract and transfer receipts
EIA registration-level compliance statement (no full EIA required)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where deficiencies are found, the salon carries out the ordered structural or operational measures (additional fire exit, ventilation adjustment, seating-density reduction, grease-trap relocation) and requests re-inspection; administrative orders are appealable within the statutory one-month period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Gewerbeamt / Ordnungsamt (trade and hospitality licensing) jointly with the Gesundheitsamt (public health authority) and Feuerwehr (fire protection authority) of the competent municipality; environmental supervision exercised by the Untere Wasserbehörde / Umweltamt.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Gaststättenerlaubnis (hospitality permit) under Section 2 Gaststättengesetz, combined with the Gewerbeanmeldung (trade notification) for a specialty tea salon; food business registration per Article 6(2) of EU Regulation 852/2004.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Umweltamt / Untere Wasserbehörde (lower-tier environmental and water authority), coordinated with the municipal sanitation authority and the federal Umweltbundesamt framework.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration tier – no full EIA under Annex 1 UVPG; a specialty tea salon is normally not an EIA project. Simplified immission-control registration may apply only where large kitchen ventilation (>25,000 m3/h) or significant oil/gas storage occurs; the mandatory procedures are the indirect-discharge registration under Section 58 WHG and waste-management notification.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater – indirect discharge only after a DIN EN 1825 grease separator; municipal sewer statutes typically set limits for COD (max. 750 mg/L), BOD5 (max. 300 mg/L), and oil/grease (max. 100 mg/L). Emissions – kitchen exhaust must meet the TA Luft odor and VOC thresholds for catering operations, with measured compliance evidence where plant capacity exceeds 25,000 m3/h; noise from lounge audio and ventilation equipment must not exceed the technical instruction noise-protection limits for mixed residential-commercial areas; waste oil and food waste must be handed to licensed disposers with documented transfer notes.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety – certification by the fire authority requires verified escape routes, fire-door ratings, spacing, and an installed and maintained extinguishing system proportionate to seating capacity, confirmed by the Brandschutzkonzept. Structural – the building office accepts the structural load certificate for seated areas, fixtures, and mezzanine installations. Occupational – all staff complete workplace-safety briefing under DGUV regulations and hold health clearance per Section 43 IfSG; the premises must be approved for temporary physical alcohol-free and food-handling operations before opening.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bundesministerium der Finanzen (Federal Ministry of Finance) and Bundeszentralamt für Steuern (BZSt, Federal Central Tax Office) — official portals www.bzst.de and www.elster.de; operational day-to-day tax supervision is exercised by the locally competent Finanzamt (revenue office) at the GmbH's registered seat, which issues the Steuernummer.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign shareholders form the GmbH through a notarized deed and register it in the Handelsregister; the Finanzamt then initiates tax enrolment via the mandatory 'Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung' to issue the statutory Steuernummer. Concurrently, the GmbH must file an application with the BZSt for the EU-wide Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer (USt-IdNr.), which is mandatory for intra-Community supplies and reverse-charge invoicing. Non-resident entities without a domestic seat or fixed establishment that make taxable supplies in Germany may register directly with the competent Finanzamt and must generally appoint a fiscal representative (steuerlicher Vertreter) for VAT law compliance; processing normally takes 1 to 4 weeks, subject to shareholder due-diligence checks.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Germany does not operate a check-the-box regime. Available elective mechanisms include: (1) corporate income tax Organschaft under Sec. 14 KStG requiring a 95% shareholding plus a profit-and-loss pooling agreement for sharing tax attributes, (2) VAT fiscal unity under Sec. 2(2) no. 2 UStG based on financial, economic, and organizational integration, (3) trade tax grouping under Sec. 2(2) GewStG, (4) the Sec. 4k EStG elections ordering hybrid mismatch treatment and anti-double-dipping, and (5) limited thin-cap and interest barrier elections under Sec. 4h EStG / Sec. 8a KStG.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (Umsatzsteuer) governed by the Umsatzsteuergesetz (UStG), harmonized with EU Council Directive 2006/112/EC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 22,000 annual turnover ceiling for the Kleinunternehmer exemption under Sec. 19 UStG; no registration threshold applies to non-established foreign suppliers, as any taxable supply in Germany triggers a VAT registration obligation; intra-EU distance-sales and OSS thresholds follow the EUR 10,000 Union-wide threshold effective 1 July 2021.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Germany implements a phased e-invoicing and reporting mandate instead of real-time fiscal clearance engines: every domestic B2B supplier must be technically able to receive structured XRechnung or ZUGFeRD/FACTUR-X e-invoices from 1 January 2025; mandatory structured-format issuance applies from 1 January 2027 for businesses with prior-year turnover exceeding EUR 800,000 and from 1 January 2028 for all domestic B2B transactions. VAT is settled periodically via Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung (monthly with Dauerfristverlängerung or quarterly) and the annual Umsatzsteuererklärung submitted through ELSTER; there is no per-invoice digital stamping or API authorization, but EU ViDA reform will introduce aligned digital transaction reporting in the medium term.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0% VAT) applies under Sec. 6 UStG to Ausfuhrlieferungen (export deliveries) where the specialty tea goods are physically dispatched or transported from Germany to a third-country destination and the border-crossing fact is duly proven; the seller, the recipient, or an independent carrier may effect shipment, and the export must be confirmed by customs. Offshore B2B services (e.g., tea-ceremony consulting or cultural-lounge franchising) are generally taxable at the customer's place of establishment under Sec. 3a UStG, giving rise to reverse charge rather than domestic VAT, while certain services to third-country non-entrepreneurs benefit from exemption under Sec. 4 no. 3 UStG.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: ATLAS customs export declaration (Ausfuhranmeldung) with assigned MRN
Official proof of export (Ausfuhrnachweis) comprising customs-stamped or electronic exit confirmation (Ausgangsvermerk)
Bill of Lading (Konnossement), CMR consignment note, or airway bill evidencing physical removal from the EU customs territory
Commercial invoice and export packing list matching the customs declaration
Inward remittance certificate or SWIFT MT103 evidencing receipt of foreign-exchange export proceeds
Certificate of origin or EUR.1 movement certificate where preferential tariff routing is claimed
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Finanzamt retrospectively claws back zero-rated output VAT if export documentation is incomplete, untimely, or internally inconsistent, imposing arrears interest of 0.5% per month under Sec. 233a AO on the VAT reassessed. Intentional export VAT evasion is prosecuted under Sec. 370 AO with imprisonment up to 10 years and fines up to the evaded amount; negligent non-declaration under Sec. 378 AO attracts penalty fines up to EUR 50,000 per finding; erroneous zero-rating triggers Sec. 14c UStG correction-invoice liability. The BZSt and Hauptzollamt may coordinate customs criminal audits, extend statutory assessment periods up to 10 years for concealed facts, and impose personal managing-director liability where the director failed to secure adequate export proof.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Deutsche Bundesbank; the Foreign Trade and Payments Regulation (AWV) payment-statistics reporting is administered by the Bundesbank's External Sector and Balance-of-Payments division. BaFin supervises banks and payment institutions, while BAFA handles export-control and restrictive-measures licensing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Germany maintains full current and capital account convertibility. Article 63 TFEU prohibits exchange controls between Member States and with most third countries. No central-bank permit is required for trade payments, capital contributions, dividend remittances, or loan servicing. Practical remittance hurdles are limited to KYC and source-of-funds verification, EU restrictive-measures screening, AWV statistical reporting for payments of EUR 12,500 or more, and, for dividends, formal balance-sheet approval and German withholding tax procedures.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. Germany imposes no statutory surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation deadline for export proceeds. Export receipts may be retained in euros or foreign currency. For balance-of-payments statistics, inward cross-border payments from non-residents of EUR 12,500 or more must be reported to Deutsche Bundesbank under the AWV in the monthly reporting cycle; the mandatory conversion ratio is zero.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Vorgründungs-/Gründerkonto) and Operational Account (EUR/USD)
Operational Account (EUR) with FX clearing and trade-services line
Operational Account (EUR/USD) and derivative execution account

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (Jahresabschluss) filed and published in the electronic Federal Gazette as part of the annual public disclosure obligation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bundesanzeiger (BAnz) via Unternehmensregister; overseen by the Federal Ministry of Justice
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Small GmbH: within 12 months after fiscal year-end; medium and large GmbH: within 4 months after fiscal year-end. For calendar-year company, small company financials for FY2025 due by 31 December 2026.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic coercive fine (Ordnungsgeld) of up to EUR 25,000 per notice; continued non-compliance can result in repeated fines and court-ordered compulsory compilation or administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Finanzamt (tax office) under the oversight of the state tax administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due 31 July of the following calendar year for calendar-year taxpayer; automatically extended to 28 February of the second following year when filed by a German tax adviser.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty (Verspätungszuschlag) up to EUR 25,000; late payment interest assessed at 0.15% per month; enforced legal liabilities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due 31 July of the following calendar year; extended to 28 February of the second following year when professionally prepared.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties as described; additionary charge of 0.5% per month on overdue trade tax; forced collection and interest.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due 31 July of the following calendar year for calendar-year taxpayer; professional preparation extension applies.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties and late payment interest at 0.15% per month; potential advance payment adjustments.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit under sections 267 and 316 HGB for medium and large GmbHs. An entity becomes subject to audit if it exceeds at least two of the following three criteria for two consecutive fiscal years: balance sheet total above EUR 6,000,000; net turnover above EUR 12,000,000; average annual workforce above 50 employees.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: German Commercial Code (HGB) German GAAP for statutory annual financial statements; IFRS is permitted for a non-listed GmbH as a voluntary alternative only in respect of consolidated reporting, while HGB remains the basis for the carrying amount and dividend fields.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Germany maintains an event-driven Transparency Register (Transparenzregister). There is no standalone annual UBO declaration; any transfer of shares or change in the beneficial ownership structure must be reported without undue delay (unverzüglich) after the change. The updated register entry must reflect the full chain of ownership.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Handelsregister records and internal directors register)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% corporate income tax (Körperschaftsteuer) plus 5.5% solidarity surcharge on CIT = 15.825%; trade tax (Gewerbesteuer) levied at municipal rate (typical 14%–17%), producing a combined effective burden of approximately 30%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holidays. Research and development allowance (Forschungszulage) up to 25% of qualifying R&D personnel expenditures; trade tax add-back and reduced-rate options relevant for small and start-up GmbHs under § 1a KStG/ § 7g EStG. Loss carryforward is indefinite, but the amount of taxable income exceeding EUR 1 million is subject to a 60% utilization cap per year.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Körperschaftsteuererklärung 202X (KSt 1 A, KSt 1 F and Mantelbogen) filed electronically via ELSTER (www.elster.de); trade tax return (Gewerbesteuererklärung) accompanies the CIT return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 31 July of the calendar year following the fiscal year (e.g. FY 2023 return due 31 July 2024). An extension to 28 February of the following year is generally granted when a professional tax adviser prepares the return. Filing must be made in e-data format through ELSTER.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company identification data: legal form, registered seat, address, tax identification number and trade register number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the German tax number and full legal name of the GmbH; any foreign shareholder numbers are not required here.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gesamtbetrag der Einkünfte – total income from tea salon operations, catering, merchandise sales, ancillary cultural events and any other domestic commercial activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only income attributable to the German permanent establishment. Foreign-source business income is generally exempt if a treaty contains a PE article and no German PE exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax loss carryforward deduction (Verlustabzug) computed in accordance with § 10d EStG: up to EUR 1 million unlimited, above that amount 60% of remaining income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the last issued loss certificate (Verlustfeststellungsbescheid) and list remaining loss carryforward in the supplementary documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of corporate income tax at 15% on taxable income plus 5.5% solidarity surcharge, before foreign tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign shareholders may claim treaty credits or reduced withholding under the applicable DTA; include Form ZV and supporting TRC if credit is claimed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Trade income calculation, including trade tax add-backs (Hinzurechnungen) and reductions (Kürzungen), leading to the trade tax assessment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This return is filed with the local municipality and is governed by the same tax authority; non-resident shareholders do not file trade tax individually.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty under § 152 AO: up to 10% of assessed tax, minimum EUR 25, maximum EUR 25,000. In addition, monthly late payment interest of 0.5% on every EUR 50 of outstanding tax; late payment penalty of 0.25% per month of unpaid tax. In severe cases, the tax office may impose an estimated assessment (Zwangsgeld – up to EUR 25,000).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% dividend withholding tax (Kapitalertragsteuer) plus 5.5% solidarity surcharge = 26.375%. For resident EU parent companies holding at least 10%, the effective rate may be 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive with proper proof.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply reduced or zero dividend withholding rates, the receiving non-resident corporation must submit (1) a valid certificate of residence (Ansässigkeitsbescheinigung / TRC) issued by the tax authority of the country of residence, and (2) a completed exemption application (Ansässigkeitsbescheinigung nach DBA-EU) filed with the Bundeszentralamt für Steuern before payment. For EU-resident parents, electronic notification via Account Management is also accepted. If tax was withheld at source, a refund claim may be filed with the German tax office against a Form KSt-1 / NV-3A within four years of the assessment.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to non-residents: statutory withholding tax 15% + 5.5% solidarity surcharge = 15.825%. Reduced treaty rates may apply (e.g. German-American DTA: 0% for certain copyright royalties; 0% for computer software royalties, otherwise 5%–10%; generally 10% for patents/trademarks). Interest paid to non-residents: ordinary business interest is not subject to German withholding unless it arises from certain registered debt instruments or profit-participating loans, in which case the statutory rate is 25% + 5.5% solidarity surcharge = 26.375%; DTA rates typically reduce this to 0%–10%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 1,000,000 (annual cross-border related-party transaction value for goods and services) triggers Local File; EUR 750,000,000 consolidated group revenue triggers Country-by-Country Reporting and Master File obligations in Germany.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Germany does not apply the UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations, but substance requirements are embedded in the German GAAR (§ 42 AO), the OECD principal purpose test (PPT) in DTAs, and CFC rules. For a GmbH operating a specialty tea salon, the tax office expects actual management and control in Germany, a physical location, staff and operational assets; a mere mailbox or non-resident management without local activity will lead to the denial of treaty benefits, reclassification of income, and potential personal liability of the directors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting cash tea sales, understating turnover in the CIT/VAT returns, fabricating expense invoices from the tea suppliers, or manipulating e-bilanz accounting records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment up to 10 years under § 370 AO; criminal fine up to EUR 10,000,000 in aggravated cases; automatic assessment of underpaid tax plus 6% annual interest; decision published in some jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal prosecution; asset seizure; travel ban under § 132a AO; no protection by the corporate veil. Directors may also be personally liable for unpaid taxes under § 69 AO and subject to disqualification.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the GmbH as a nominal entity only; the specialty tea salon is operated from outside Germany or controlled exclusively by a foreign parent without real local employees, substantive contracts, or local decision-making.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax office ignores the GmbH as the taxable entity, treats the income as directly derived by the foreign shareholder, applies dividend withholding tax (26.375%), and denies treaty relief under abuse-of-law principles; AStG CFC rules may also apply to passive income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors face personal penalty after a § 69 AO claim; restitution of unlawfully avoided corporate taxes; compulsory appearance restrictions; liability to creditor claims when insolvency was concealed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file beneficial owner information in the German Transparenzregister (Transparency Register), failure to identify customers for cash payments above EUR 10,000, or failure to appoint an AML officer when matching turnover thresholds; insufficient internal controls for cash-based tea lounge operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines under the German Geldwäschegesetz (GwG) of up to EUR 5,000,000 for legal entities (or 10% of total annual turnover); disgorgement of profits; block on the Transparenzregister entries prevents distributions; periodic publication of the fine is possible.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face individual fines up to EUR 5,000,000 for deliberate breaches; disqualification orders; under § 8 GwG they are personally liable for truthful register submissions and for the annual verification of shareholder registration.
